assets.name: spa-room
assets.prompt: Premium illustrated background for a relaxing skincare casual game, charming Pixar-inspired art direction rendered as a polished hand-painted 2.5D storybook environment, soft warm pastel rose, ivory and lavender. A dreamy boutique spa room viewed front on, airy peach-pink plaster walls, pale blush arched recess, sheer curtains at far edges, delicate plant leaves at very far corners, little cosmetic bottles and folded towels low in extreme corners. MAIN REQUIREMENT: central 75 percent of image is a beautifully calm light warm pink wall with subtle painterly illumination, empty clean space for an overlaid large face and interface. Gentle morning sunlight from upper left, soft volumetric warmth, exquisite soft material shading, optimistic cozy atmosphere. Composition symmetric and flat enough for a game, no perspective distortion. Quiet low contrast background, not busy, no furniture in center, no green or gray cast, no text, no UI, no people, no mirror or reflected person. Full bleed landscape image, usable cropped to portrait with center still quiet. Beautiful professional mobile game environment, sophisticated hand-painted brush texture, no web gradients.

assets.prompt: Production game sprite sheet, exactly TWO separate horizontal ribbons in a single column, top pink and bottom warm golden yellow. Central face occupies 75% of ribbon width, its center is exactly the visual center vertically, absolutely ample EMPTY area for a two word heading. Top ribbon blush pink with rose shadows. Both entire ribbons isolated on perfectly flat pure cyan #00ffff including margins, 15% empty outer margins and a large cyan gap between the two rows. Sharp high resolution. Each ribbon ratio 4.5 wide by 1 high. NO cast shadows on cyan.
